advisory.situation: CRITICAL at 60s in Gate Throat. 125 people tracked; peak local density 4.86 persons/m2; mean speed 0.63 m/s; crowd pressure 3.460 s^-2. Fused risk 0.94 (high). Over the last 60s: density 0.1 to 4.9 persons/m2 (+10461%); mean speed 0.00 to 0.63 m/s; occupancy 2 to 125 (+123).
advisory.mechanism: High density with near-zero speed and low disorder: the crowd is jammed, not flowing. Pressure now accumulates from behind with no release path.
advisory.root_cause: Static Blockage detected at confidence 0.36. Measured evidence: dense crowd at a standstill (4.86/m2, 0.63 m/s); stopped across a broad front, not funnelled (87% of the corridor width).
actions: CONTROL: stop inflow to Gate Throat at Approach -- the crowd is jammed and pressure is accumulating from behind.
MARSHALS: identify and clear the obstruction at the head of the jam; that is the only real fix. Assemble at Gate Throat downstream side.
CONTROL: open a release path in the crowd's existing direction of travel.
SUPERVISOR: if the jam does not move within 60 seconds, escalate to a crush response.
advisory.do_not: Do NOT broadcast messages that cause people to turn around -- reversing a jammed crowd creates counter-flow inside the jam.
advisory.broadcast: The route ahead is temporarily blocked. Please hold your position and do not push. Staff are clearing it now.
